title: Can't Buy Me Love
tagline: A thousand dollars buys a girlfriend. Not dinner.
about: A nerdy teenager pays the most popular girl at school to pretend to date him for a month.
cue: Serve the snacks when Ronald and Cindy sit down to lunch as part of the deal.
faces: A thousand dollars got me the cool table. Dinner is cheaper and the company is better.
